motivation: Original M95 applies three independent per-token FFNs after hierarchical aggregation. This source graph fact permits an explicit alternative: retain three scale-specific nonlinearities but jointly compose information through the actual three-level support forest. No measured task deficit or diagnosed accuracy cause is asserted.

variables.L: unweighted combinatorial Laplacian on original true-supported fine->middle->coarse membership edges, component per original coarse root
variables.A: I+L, exactly unit identity and unit original edges, no selectable diffusion coefficient
variables.S: A inverse applied by scalar metadata Schur elimination and feature Tensor back-substitution
variables.U_l: original FFN_l(Z_l), exactly once per full original bank

hypothesis: Whole-forest linear analysis and synthesis around scale-specific nonlinear FFNs may change the quality of the original hierarchy message delivered to native inst_feats/masks. Efficacy and causal benefit UNKNOWN.
boundary: Only point-supported original nodes are in the forest. Unsupported/batch-pad rows use identity during both solves and retain original per-row FFN/skip semantics; they are never graph nodes or fake parents. No point-level transport or root-to-root edges.
matched_control: Original M95 entire graph under exact original YAML/data/pretrain/seed/optimizer/precision/two TRAIN batches and unchanged resource handlers. Whole-graph alternative, not an isolated causal attribution.
degeneracies: If the analysis/synthesis graph has no edges, S=I and supported rows reduce to original M95 exactly in real arithmetic; the production three-level forest usually contains edges even for one real point. This is a mathematical control, not a newly run native arm.

Three scale-specific FFNs remain distinct. If every feature and FFN response is constant across a component, the solver preserves that constant; this does not mean the nonlinear whole graph preserves original input means.

near_neighbors.HRC: One-way bottom-up child means and updated banks; HPC solves a fixed bidirectional SPD tree system both before and after original nonlinearities.
near_neighbors.BEC: Learned nonlinear two-way membership-edge maps with private upward means and downward branches; HPC keeps all original FFNs and adds no learned edge map.
near_neighbors.PSNC: Same-parent middle-only orthonormal DCT conjugation; HPC nonorthogonal resolvent acts jointly across fine/middle/coarse and synthesis is S, not S inverse.
near_neighbors.CRE: Directed supported-root joint messages then ancestor decode, with explicit root-to-root interactions; HPC has disconnected original coarse-root components and no new maps.
near_neighbors.AEF: Same-parent middle MST signed edge fluxes; HPC uses original adjacent-scale membership edges with non-antisymmetric resolvent composition.
near_neighbors.RSTR_PCE: Neither fixed point-mass reversible sibling transport nor physical contact point exchange; all failed/held routes, revisions and numerical gates remain intact. No mean gate inherited.

bounded_history_scope: 143 current IDs/hypothesis summaries searched locally for diffusion/solve/implicit/covariance/Gram/channel/polynomial terms and direct recent graph source facts. Not a full-history proof or literature novelty audit.
family: Fixed graph propagation / resolvent filtering family acknowledged; original-paper novelty NOT_VERIFIED.
predefined_disposition: Missing actual native core support/path coverage => INCONCLUSIVE, no resampling to force it.
Any native nonfinite loss/backward or failed required original parameter update => fail closed with evidence, not automatic new numerical tolerance.
Original <=10G uniform resource threshold and relative memory condition remain; no unregistered exception.
No effect or novelty claim before actual training and appropriate controls.
